risks_a: Upload reimplements option handling, request dispatch, response decoding, and missing-data handling instead of routing the multipart body through FilesService.Add as explicitly required.

The RawClient change buffers every unrecognized reader whenever WithNoRetry is absent, broadly changing Add, Update, and unrelated reader-backed requests despite the contract requiring Add behavior and retry machinery to remain unchanged.
Buffering is keyed only to the per-request no-retry marker, so requests may be buffered even when the configured retry policy would not retry them.
risks_b: Upload has the wrong public option type and cannot accept arbitrary existing FilesOption values as the required signature promises.
Upload also bypasses FilesService.Add and duplicates its request/response logic.
